The '''Perilix system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within an unknown [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Perilix]].
